coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property leased or subleased for dwelling purposes. Dwelling units in one-family or two-family dwellings are excluded; the statute states this exclusion without regard to owner occupancy. In effect, it covers buildings with 3 or more dwelling units.
coverage.other_conditions: Does not apply to a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property.

result.notes: min_units=3 is derived from the exclusion of one-family and two-family dwellings in subsection c.(1). Owner occupancy does not matter to that exclusion. requires_unknown_facts=false because the rule covers ordinary rental buildings. The Real Estate Commission licensee carve-out is about who charges the fee, not about the building, so it stays in other_conditions rather than coverage limits. There is no construction-date limit, new-construction exemption, or local-preemption language.
